title: Serialized MultiSWAP v1 technical reference

frozen_source_owners.role: multi-column serialized orchestration, registry preflight, deterministic dispatch, per-column transaction/commit and aggregate diagnostics
logical column/template contracts, execution order and aggregate diagnostic types
qualified per-column reference-physics backend and worker-local solver/workspace ownership
typed physical-state compatibility used by committed-boundary restart

preservation_authority.status_a_current_preservation: same-tree F-GC29 serialized MultiSWAP observable and aggregate-mass replay plus retained mixed-smoke/permanent suites

permitted_claims: Serialized MultiSWAP v1 executes qualified real-physics logical columns serially through one runtime composition.
Logical columns carry identities and registry handles while mutable committed state remains per-column and solver/Newton/Jacobian scratch is non-persistent worker/backend state.
The frozen runtime validates the complete registry structure before physical execution, including uniqueness of state claims.
Execution order is deterministic under the v1 policy: template_id then column_id.
Each resolved column uses the existing checkpoint/trial/retry/commit or rollback transaction lifecycle; rejected work does not become committed column state.
Batch and aggregate diagnostics are composed from per-column results and include aggregate unrounded mass residual; mass conservation remains a hard qualified gate.
Committed-boundary restart persists continuation authority while excluding solver scratch.
Typed optional persistent state is conditional on the admitted physical profile rather than forced on every logical column.
forbidden_claims: No parallel or concurrent real-physics MultiSWAP admission.
No thread/process safety or shared mutable-state claim for arbitrary concurrency.
No worker-scaling, SIMD/GPU, 100k-column throughput or general speedup claim.
No RossFast or mixed Reference/RossFast MultiSWAP claim inside the frozen Status-A denominator.
No broad MODFLOW or direct-groundwater MultiSWAP claim beyond separately admitted authorities.
No general filesystem/byte-format or cross-version restart claim.
No mid-transaction/trial-state restart or persistence of solver scratch.
No automatic safety inheritance for future process state or execution topologies.
next_permitted_action: Write reviewer-facing Serialized MultiSWAP v1 technical reference without broadening the frozen authority ceiling.
